effect.fr: Tente de capturer un Pokémon du Concours de Capture d'insecte du Parc Naturel. (Gén II: Parc Ball)
effect.en: Tries to catch a Pokémon in the Bug-Catching contest in National Park. (Gen II: Park Ball)

flavor.en: A special Poké Ball that was used during the Bug-Catching Contest in the Johto region.
flavor.ko: 성도지방의 곤충채집 대회에서 사용되었던 특별한 볼.
